sUSD is a synthetic stablecoin designed to track the US dollar. sUSD is minted against collateral staked in the Synthetix protocol. sUSD is issued on the Ethereum blockchain.

Spark is a decentralized lending protocol. Spark is built as a fork of the Aave V3 codebase. Spark is associated with the Sky ecosystem, formerly known as MakerDAO.

Aerodrome is a decentralized exchange. Aerodrome operates on the Base network. Aerodrome is a fork of the Velodrome codebase. Aerodrome uses a vote-escrowed tokenomics model with its AERO token.

ether.fi is a non-custodial liquid staking and restaking protocol. ether.fi operates on the Ethereum blockchain. ether.fi issues the eETH liquid staking token.
